scientific_integrity: The proof uses the exact record recurrence, a complete case split on the least prime not dividing one less than the preceding record, and a specialized proof that \(23\#+1\) is itself a record. The finite replay is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem identifies the first failure of the \(25\pmod{30}\) record progression only. It does not classify later record multiples of \(5\) or the corresponding patterns for other primes.
title: First break in the period-\(30\) record-multiple pattern
